title: Rhythm Copycat
shareTitle: Rhythm Copycat 🥁 — copy the kawaii kitten's claps, stomps, taps and shakes
description: Kiki the kawaii kitten plays a beat on her sticker-band stage. Listen, then copy it back in time — clap, stomp, tap and shake! A body-percussion rhythm game.
learningGoals: Hear and copy short body-percussion rhythm patterns
Match sounds to actions in a steady beat
Feel tempo and stay in time with a beat
interactionModel: watch the kawaii kitten demo a beat, then tap the matching sticker pads in time to play it back
feedbackModel: every beat can be finished: wrong pads wiggle with a spoken nudge, missed beats replay once, and the round always ends in a song and a cheer

modes.title: Drum Circle
modes.skill: copy 3–4 beat patterns at a faster tempo

credits: All art generated locally with the QLOBE LAN pipeline (Krea 2, Qwen Image Edit, Qwen Image Layered, Ideogram 4, Qwen3 TTS voice clone). Kawaii sticker style per the ui-mockups. See ASSETS.md. Built for QLOBE Kids.
